body:
So i got banned because some dude "Ben_Dover" combatlogged on me, and yes i had no proff, but he started pissing me off, and some guy who was acting like a mod (we all know that type of player) got a mod and got screenshots of me calling him out, Yes i accept i got mad and talked trash to him, but i find it unfair that i got punished and he ddnt. so im a leader of a avicus team [PeruanCombo] and the tourney is getting colser... thats why i need to get unbanned.. the only way to practice and study the maps is by playing in the server. theres no other way... I hope someone can helps me. thiswont happen ever again. thx
